 Oral Order
4 18-12-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State but in spite of putting appearance through vakalatnama none is present on behalf of opposite party no.2 2.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 498A and 120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.18587 of 2021(4) dt.18-12-2023 dowry demand.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.

Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor drove her out of her Ajit Kumar Charan vs The State Of Bihar on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132132693/
1 matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.

sentences.text: He is still ready to keep her with full honour and dignity as stated in para-7 of this application.

The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs.
The State of Bihar, reported in 2006 (3) PLJR 182.
5.

sentences.text:
In that view of the matter, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Complaint Case No.3785 (C) of 2015, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.,
6.

If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the learned Court below for Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.18587 of 2021(4) dt.18-12-2023 referring the matter to the District Mediation Center for the purpose of reconciliation or for one time settlement.
7. Accordingly, this application stands disposed of.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) Trivedi/-
